description.narrative: Benin - Access To Justice Project - Courts Activity: The activity will allow Benin to move forward its ten year plan for improvement of the judiciary by providing basic training, court management, guidance, and physical and institutional infrastructure. MCC Funding will support the following activities: (i) Training of judges and court personnel. (ii) Inspection General Service. (iii) Legal Information Center.

condition.narrative: Approval of Environmental and Social Assessment Framework, (including site selection criteria) and an EMP for the Legal Information Center.
Approval of court design and information technology plan to ensure conformity with EU courts project
Commitment of budgetary resources by the Government sufficient to support new judges and staff and to maintain new courts as evidenced in the national budget

Compliance with the EMP for the Legal Information Center and all permits required for construction of the Legal Information Center shall have been issued and in full force and effect (including expiration of any appeal period) and all disclosure and consultation requirements met
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
MCC approval of EMP and Resettlement Action Plans (if needed) and implementation of these plans in accordance with World Bank Operational Policy 4,12 on Involuntary Resettlement

MCC approval of new rules and procedures for case management developed according to review of current processes; implementation of enhanced case management techniques by courts and implementation of the case management system developed based on recommendations formed pursuant to Section 2 (c)(vi)
Ongoing compliance with EMP (for separate environmental assessment per guidance in framework assessment ) for each courthouse; ongoing monitoring of any resettlement
Procedural codes and other codes described in Section 2 (c)(v)(1) of Schedule 3 to Annex 1 are passed and remain in effect
